metrics.name: Yield per session
metrics.intent: Unique campaign-fit ops added to the intake queue in the last 24 hours. Zero if nothing queued today — not the last productive session restamped.
metrics.insight: Same number as Queued last 24h. Zero means harvest did not land unique ops in 24h.

metrics.name: Queued last 24h
metrics.intent: Unique ops added to the intake queue in the last 24 hours (pending still waiting + already ingested). Same slice as session_yield.
metrics.insight: Zero = nothing unique landed for intake today. Rising here with flat pipeline indexed_24h = intake/dispatch is the next question.

metrics.name: Yield per harvester
metrics.intent: Mean unique queued ops in the last 24 hours across every registered harvest-layer tool. Zeros included — one hot tool is not the layer average. agent_rd is shown, not averaged in.
metrics.insight: Queued last 24h divided by harvest_tool_growth. 28 ops and 12 tools is ~2.3, not 28. One tool at 28 with eleven at 0 is concentration, not capacity.

metrics.name: Campaign targets met
metrics.intent: Share of per-harvester weekly yield targets met in 14 days, across enabled campaigns. Not a campaign count. Each enabled campaign declares a weekly target per harvester; this is the share of those targets met. 40% means 2 of 5 targets hit. A session yield of 2 ops cannot fill five weekly targets, so read it against session_yield before concluding a route has failed.
metrics.insight: Each unmet row is a ready-made PIT brief; all met + index canaries failing = loss is downstream of discovery.

metrics.name: Verify rate
metrics.insight: Falling = routes decaying or probing broken; no_data at scanned=0 = layer idle (see harvest_pulse).

metrics.name: Harvest pulse
metrics.intent: Days since the layer last yielded.
metrics.insight: days_since_yield diverging from days_since_any_session = running but useless, distinct from not running.

metrics.name: Tokens per op
metrics.intent: Cursor Cloud Agent tokens spent on discovery, divided by unique verified ops in the same 7 days. Personal/other-subsystem agents are excluded.
metrics.insight: Falling = yield growing faster than spend. Rising = agents doing work the harvest layer should have codified.

metrics.name: Harvest tool growth
metrics.intent: Registered automated harvesters - the growth plate that SHOULD grow.
metrics.insight: Tool count times yield-per-harvester is discovery capacity; flat count while agent R&D keeps finding sources = D5 codification loop failing.

metrics.name: Code restraint
metrics.intent: Churn without net growth outside the plates.
metrics.insight: Net growth should concentrate in harvesters/ (the plate); broad growth elsewhere is debt.

metrics.name: Patch churn
metrics.intent: Files appearing in >=3 git commits in 30 days (from git log, not harness metadata).
metrics.insight: Hot files outside harvesters/ = patching substituting for design.

metrics.name: Realised design smell
metrics.intent: Stock score of design-subversion habits + narration on the current your-discovery-repo tree (scorecard classifiers, no plates, not a git diff).
metrics.insight: Trend over absolute: rising smell with flat harvest_tool_growth = the loop is patching instead of compounding tools.

metrics.name: Open escalations
metrics.insight: Nonzero = the loop is holding work; age matters more than count - the same change held across two cycles means the landing seam failed.
